tools.name: abort_sequence
tools.description: Aborts the sequence and resets to IDLE. Valid from any state during the sequence.

tools.name: calculate_fuel
tools.description: Calculates the required fuel amount and oxidizer ratio based on the target trajectory.

tools.name: get_page_state
tools.description: Returns the current rocket state (status and fuel level). If the user asks to launch a rocket, automatically execute this step first without asking for confirmation.

tools.name: ignite_engines
tools.description: Fires the rocket engines, transitioning from PREPARED to LAUNCHED. Only valid when status is PREPARED — follow the full prerequisite chain first.

tools.name: load_fuel
tools.description: Loads propellants. Transitions from DIAGNOSTICS to FUELED. Only valid when status is DIAGNOSTICS.

tools.name: prepare_launch
tools.description: Transitions the system from FUELED to PREPARED. Requires the user's 4-digit auth_code — ask the user, never guess it. Only valid when status is FUELED.

auth_code.description: 4-digit authorization code. Must be obtained from the user.

tools.name: reset_system
tools.description: Resets the system to IDLE with full fuel. Valid from any state.

tools.name: run_diagnostics
tools.description: Runs system checks. Transitions from IDLE to DIAGNOSTICS. Only valid when status is IDLE.
